text:
mia_csm: Heads up — OptiRetail usage down ~45% last 14 days. Saw the dip after their internal Q1 reorg; Laura (our main contact) moved teams and Sarah (new PM) is MIA. Also spotted a short PoC from PilotX last week :eyes:. Anyone else tracking?

jason_se: I pulled API logs — embedding calls are the biggest drop, generation/rerank still running but lower volume. No infra alerts on our side.

dena_csm: I got a DM from Laura yesterday. Her note: 'we're re-evaluating cost + latency, worried about token spend and some 95/99th spikes.' She asked if we can give a performance/price comparison.

ryan_support: No SRE incidents. Could be client-side SDK change or they toggled a model param. Do we have a prompt snapshot from them to diff?

mia_csm: I copied the user prompt they shared last month for reference: ```system: You are a retail product assistant. user: summarize cart items with upsell suggestions, tone friendly, max_tokens 120``` Might be they increased temperature or changed streaming approach.

jason_se: I'll run a quick compare between the variant they were on (redwood-v1/8k) and the smaller quantized profile they tried. Will check 99th latency and token cost delta. ETA EOD today. :thumbsup:

dena_csm: I'll try to get a 30-min sync with Sarah + Laura for next Tue. Goal: confirm who's driving the renewal and learn PilotX scope. I'll ask for any alt prompts they've tested.

sophie_sales: If they're worried about cost we can offer a short Dedicated trial (discounted) to show unit economics and stable latency. I can draft an offer once we get usage baselines.

mia_csm: Good. Also recommend we run a quick eval on their top 50 prompts for quality regressions if they switched models — that would address product concerns.

jason_se: Agree. I'll save sample traces and a perf summary + recommended model/batch settings. If we can show 20-30% token cost reduction with similar QoR, helps retention case.

ops-bot: deploy/patch v infra-metrics 2026-07-11 14:02 - no anomalies detected.

mia_csm: Next steps recap — 1) jason: perf + cost comparison (EOD) 2) dena: schedule call with Sarah/Laura (by Tue) 3) sophie: draft Dedicated trial proposal after baseline. I'll mark account health: at-risk-high and update the renewal tracker.

sophie_sales: I'll stand by to join the call. If we can get a short log extract from the customer beforehand that shows decreased embedding calls, we can tailor pricing.

mia_csm: thanks team. tagging follow-ups here. i'll post the call link and prep notes once dena confirms. :pray:
